description: Namaste AI — Free handwritten notes and study material covering AI concepts from the Namaste AI course. Explore the history of AI, neural networks, deep learning, transformers, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, and more. An open-source learning resource by Chetan Nada.
